div.head: Af El. 12
div.ab: Ðeah hwa gebicge his dohter to þeowte, ne beo heo alles swa þeow swa oðer þeowwifman: nage he hy utt on ælþeodig folc to syllanne. Ac gif he hyre ne recce, se þe hy bohte, læte hy frige on ælþeodig folc. Gif he þonne alyfe hys sune mid to hæmenne, do hyre gifta 7 locie þæt heo hæbbe hrægl; 7 þæt sy wurð hire mægþhades, þæt his se wítuma, agyfe hire þene. Gif he hyre þare nanne ne dó, þonne sy heo freoh.

Ðeah hwa gebycgge his dohtor on þeowenne, ne sie hio ealles swa ðeowu swa oðru mennenu: nage he hie út on elðeodig folc to bebycgganne. Ac gif he hire ne recce, se ðe hie bohte, læte hie freo on elðeodig folc. Gif he ðonne alefe his suna mid to hæmanne, do hiere gyfta: locige þæt hio hæbbe hrægl; ⁊ þæt weorð sie hiere mægðhades, þæt is se weotuma, agife he hire þone. Gif he hire þara nan ne do, þonne sie hio frioh.

Ðeah hwa gebicge his dohtor ón ðeowenne, ne sie he ealles swa ðeowu swa oðre mennenu: nage he hí ut on ælðeodig folc to bebycganne. Ac gif he hyre ne recce, se ðe hie bohte, læte hie faran freo on ælðeodig folc. Gif he þonne alyfe his sunea mid to hæmanne, dó hyre gifta: locie þæt heo habbe hrægl; ⁊ þæt weorð sie hyre mægðhades, þæt is sie wituma, agyfe he hyre ðone. Gif he hire þara nan ne do, ðonne sie heo freoh.

Si quis uendiderit filiam suam in famulam, non egredietur sicut ancille exire consueuerunt. Si displicuerit oculis domini sui cui tradita fuerat, dimittet eam; populo autem alieno uendendi non habebit potestatem, si spreuerit eam. Sin autem filio suo desponderit eam, iuxta morem filiarum faciet illi. Quodsi ei alteram acceperit, prouidebit puelle nuptias et uestimenta et precium pudicitie non negabit. Si ista tria non fecerit, egredietur gratis absque pecunia.

Ðeah hwa gebycgge his dohtor on þeowenne, ne sie hio ealles swa ðeowu swa oðru mennenu: nage he hie ut on elðeodig folc to bebycgganne. Ac gif he hire ne recce, se ðe hie bohte, læte hie freo on elðeodig folc. Gif he ðonne alefe his suna mid to hæmanne, do hiere gyfta: locige þæt hio hæbbe hrægl; ⁊ þæt weorð sie hiere mægðhades, þæt is se weotuma, agife he hire þone. Gif he hire þara nan ne do, þonne sie hio frioh.

Though someone should buy his [the Christian slave’s] daughter in servitude, let her not be entirely as much a slave as other maidservants: he has not the power to sell her to a strange people. But if he does not like her, whom he bought, he shall let her go free among a strange folk. However, if he allows his son to have her, let him [the son] give her [marriage-] gifts: let him look that she have clothing; and the worth of her maidenhood, that is the bride-price, let him give her that. If he does none of these things for her, then let her be free.

Wenngleich jemand seine Tochter zur Sklavin verkauft, so sei sie nicht gänzlich so Sklavin wie andere Unfreie. Er habe nicht Gewalt, sie auswärts an fremdes Volk zu verkaufen. Aber wenn der, welcher sie gekauft hat, ihrer nicht achtet, lasse er sie frei zu fremdem Volke. Wenn er aber seinem Sohne erlaubt, ihr beizuwohnen, so besorge er ihr die Hochzeit (und) sehe zu, dass sie Kleidung habe; und was der Preis ihrer Jungfernschaft ist, das heisst das Wittum, das gebe er ihr. Wenn er ihr keines von diesen [Dingen] schafft, dann sei sie frei.

Even if someone sells his daughter as a slave, she is not to be entirely a slave like other unfree women. He is not to have power to sell her abroad to a foreign people. But if the one who bought her does not care for her, let him let her go free to a foreign people. If, however, he allows his son to lie with her, let him provide her with the wedding (and) see that she has clothing; and what the price of her maidenhood is, that is the dower, let him give her that. If he provides her with none of these [things], then let her be free.
